import boto3

def aggregate_metric_stats(metric_name, start_time, end_time):
    cloudwatch = boto3.client('cloudwatch')
    response = cloudwatch.get_metric_statistics(
        Namespace='AWS/EC2',
        MetricName=metric_name,
        Dimensions=[{
            'Name': 'InstanceId',
            'Value': 'i-0123456789abcdef0'
        }],
        StartTime=start_time,
        EndTime=end_time,
        Period=300,
        Statistics=['Average', 'Sum', 'SampleCount', 'Minimum', 'Maximum']
    )
    return response

import boto3

def dashboard_note_translate(note, source_lang, target_lang):
    translate = boto3.client('translate')
    response = translate.translate_text(
        Text=note,
        SourceLanguageCode=source_lang,
        TargetLanguageCode=target_lang
    )
    return response.TranslatedText

import boto3

def metrics_export_archive(metric_data, bucket_name):
    s3 = boto3.client('s3')
    s3.put_object(
        Body=metric_data,
        Bucket=bucket_name,
        Key='metrics/export.json'
    )
